Name: Pre-Show Party Bus
Description: Kenny got us a party bus and he's been so kind as to give you the keys to the music. Its the first show of the run and we are fucking ready to go. You have first choice to get the party started. What do you go with?

Name: Song Released this Year
Description: Its 2025 already baby! So many amazing releases already. Whats your fav?

Name: Funk and Soul Cave
Description: aka the best spotify playlist of all time, Spunds first baby. Pick a track from his days of perfectly curated choice tunes.

Name: Stargazing in the middle of nowhere
Description: You are on a trip up in maine, or Muskoka, or the beautiful deserts out west. Its late at night and the sky is absolutely perfect. Stars galore, clusters of galaxies, and meteor showers. You lay down with your drink and/or smoke of choice and find the perfect song to accompany you on your exploratory journey through the cosmos.

Name: B-Level (or below) Jam Band
Description: Pick a fav studio track from a b-level or c-level or even lower level jam band. they are people too and deserve their spot in the pantheon of one of our fav music genres.

Name: Desert Island SONG
Description: *PLEASE READ CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE* face it. Desert island album for this group would be boring. We’d get scarlet from Cornell 77, hood from a live one, some random skinshape song, and some soul would post the way it is from here comes the noisemakers. Instead pick a song that fits the following vibe: lying by yourself on a desert island, sun and skies are perfect, breeze on your face, salt water parched lips, and not a care in the world knowing your best friend Wilson is right by your side

Name: Best under the radar 90s pop song
Description: Every once in a while its fun to throw on a track at a post show that harkens a nostalgic dance party. Vivs runs from the other room "Oh my god I love this song! I havent heard it in ages!" Its a smash hit and we all love life.

Name: Best Nepo Baby Song
Description: Favorite song from an artist with a famous parent (or two).

Name: Sexiest Song Ever
Description: Lights dim (or fully on if you prefer), mood is right, its time to make love baby. Push play and Lets. Get. It. On.

Name: Current Jam
Description: A song right now that you just cant get enough of. Share it with the rest of us please!

Name: Dope Collabs aka Zeez McSqueeze and the Kenny's of Doom
Description: Pick a song featuring artists you love playing together. It could be called out on the track or someone who played with someone else on a studio track that we never expected until you call it out.

Name: Phish Cover
Description: Song you WISH phish would cover but they never had.

Name: World Best Sound System
Description: You get to soundcheck the world's best sound system but you only have one song to play. What do you pick? Make sure you put on your best headphones for this one....

Name: Work Out
Description: Great songs for a work out playlist and/or songs that get your heart pumping.

Name: Gone too soon
Description: Song from an artist that we lost way too soon

Name: Movie Soundtrack
Description: A song off of your fav movie soundtrack. Feel free to provide context to the needle drop moment.

Name: Get Up and Dance
Description: It's a dance party. Where? could be a club, could be a basement bar in austin or detroit, could be your house, or could be following Dianna's speaker walking through lot. Its time to get your mother fucking dance on.

Name: Best Jerry
Description: Your fav Jerry. Studio, Live, Solo, Whatever you want.
